# Support

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](SUPPORT.vi.md)

For reproducible problems, open a GitHub Issue using the appropriate template. Please include the commit SHA, Ruby/Rails versions, database environment, reproduction steps, and sanitized error messages.

Check [Documentation](../docs/index.md), [Troubleshooting](../docs/troubleshooting.md), and [Security Policy](SECURITY.md) first. Never include passwords, bearer tokens, verification links, user-uploaded face photos, or unredacted database exports.

Support covers project behavior and documented configuration; it does not include operating unverified live face identification in production.
